They are not treated as a proof of the Gitik-specific proper-class support lemma: items 14–17 of this consumer prove that machinery locally, so no logical item dependency on the still-in-progress remainder of the supplier page is hidden.

Declared page prerequisite from batch 6. As the group-c reviewer of both batches I rechecked the five item interfaces this consumer names: the PFA definition (nonempty proper partial orders, at most omega_1 dense sets, stronger-is-smaller filter convention), the master-condition definition with the predensity formulation, the master-condition characterizations, ccc-implies-proper, and the formal supercompact consistency corollary. Those five suppliers are now accepted in research/phase-2-next-18-alpha-c-5a-decisions.json together with both A/B page files, so the earlier workflow-only reason for leaving this row open no longer holds. The consumer proves the omega_1-generated ideal dichotomy locally, so it needs no PID material from this supplier.

The current authored supplier defines PFA for nonempty proper posets and at most omega_1 dense sets in the stronger-is-smaller convention, including empty families. Its contract is complete and its confidence-1 author decision is current. The consumer uses precisely this convention to obtain filters for Abraham's local proper and ccc posets; it does not specialize PID. Statement, use, contract and decision were rechecked after supplier completion.

The completed supplier defines (M,P)-genericity as predensity of D intersect M below q, a master below p, and properness in sufficiently large well-ordered H_theta structures. Its complete contract and confidence-1 repaired decision were rechecked. The local Abraham side-condition proof establishes exactly this predicate for the condition obtained by adjoining M intersect H(aleph_2).

The completed supplier proves that compatibility with a member of every D intersect M below each extension is equivalent to the master-condition predicate and reconciles the all-model and club formulations. Its complete contract and confidence-1 repaired decision were rechecked. This is exactly the criterion established for the consumer's finite side-condition forcing.

The consumer's second finite-colouring forcing is proved ccc by two Delta-system thinnings and then treated as proper. The completed supplier proves exactly ccc implies proper via countable maximal antichains in elementary models; its complete contract and confidence-1 accepted decision were rechecked. This direct dependency was added during scaffold repair and is not inferred from PFA itself.

The completed supplier proves for fixed certified arithmetizations that PA derives Con(ZFC+supercompact) implies Con(ZFC+PFA) from a verified target-refutation-to-source-refutation compiler, and explicitly makes no countable-transitive-model inference. Its exact Statement, complete contract and confidence-1 accepted author decision were rechecked. The consumer composes only this implication with its local primitive-recursive replacement of the no-S-space axiom by the fixed ZFC+PFA proof.
